games.description: A solo VHS-style exploration that remains unfinished. Sark follows an elevator into more utility rooms, examines the lighting and music, and searches for a route beyond a glass door before ending the visit.
games.title: Backrooms: Last Room

games.description: A solo exploration framed by Mr A’s account of a discarded camera. Sark follows the narrated footage through concrete halls, mall and museum spaces, poolrooms and the interview’s conclusion.
games.title: Backward poiesis

games.description: Sark starts with a laboratory’s power and time-machine puzzles, then explores the yellow-room maze. Crashes and an elusive progression trigger leave the solo visit unfinished after a final attempt with ray tracing disabled.
games.title: Echoes of The Backrooms

games.description: An unfinished solo attempt at the early-development maze game. Sark searches for a key while avoiding bacteria and the Smiler, repeatedly dies or gets stuck, then encounters the Unity debug interface and stops when the route breaks.
games.title: Into the Backrooms: Last Tape

games.description: Sark and NFEN explore Float Studios’ Bedrock Backrooms map, gathering six keys across the offices, hotel, Academy, pools and pipe tunnels. A walkthrough helps resolve the hidden final keys before they unlock the exit and reach the apartment.
games.title: Minecraft: The Backrooms

games.description: Sark enters an experimental facility and returns after a Minecraft detour. The short exploration tests the fear meter, hunts keys through the oversized rooms and ends at a numerical puzzle.
games.title: Secret Backrooms 2

games.description: Sark explores echoing pools, tries their ladders, buttons and water puzzles, and loses progress after clipping through the floor.
games.title: The Wetrooms: Liminal Pools

games.description: Sark follows a synthetic-voiced guide through a strange warehouse and reaches a surprisingly short ending.
games.title: ZonZon
